name: One More Bite
author: Nick Hamze

sections.description:
The One More Bite is a powerful and comprehensive solution for food bloggers, recipe websites, and cooking enthusiasts. This block transforms your WordPress site into a professional recipe platform with advanced features that enhance both content creation and user experience.

Core Features:

  • Structured Recipe Input: Organized fields for ingredients, instructions, prep time, cook time, and serving information
  • Unit Conversion: Built-in metric/imperial conversion for ingredients
  • Nutritional Information: Automatic calculation of calories, macros, and nutritional values
  • Recipe Scaling: Dynamic serving size adjustment that recalculates all ingredients
  • Rich Text Instructions: Full formatting support with step-by-step images
  • Drag & Drop Reordering: Intuitive ingredient and instruction management
  • Difficulty & Cost Indicators: Visual indicators for recipe complexity and estimated cost per serving

Advanced Features:

  • Meal Planning Calendar: Integrated calendar widget for planning weekly meals
  • Shopping List Generator: Consolidates ingredients across multiple recipes
  • Recipe Rating System: User reviews and star ratings
  • Dietary Restriction Filters: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, keto, and custom diet labels
  • Recipe Search & Filtering: Site-wide recipe discovery with advanced filters
  • SEO Optimization: Structured data markup for rich snippets in search results

Frontend Features:

  • Print-Friendly Layout: Optimized formatting for recipe printing
  • Social Sharing: Built-in sharing buttons for popular social platforms
  • Save to Favorites: User account integration for recipe bookmarking
  • Mobile Responsive: Optimized display across all devices
  • Step-by-Step Mode: Interactive cooking mode with large text and images

The One More Bite is designed for both novice and professional cooks, providing an intuitive editing experience while delivering a rich, interactive frontend experience for your recipe visitors.

Advanced Usage

The One More Bite can be extended with custom hooks and filters for advanced recipe management systems. It integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce for recipe-to-product connections and supports custom post types for recipe collections.

For developers, the block provides extensive JavaScript APIs for custom recipe management interfaces and third-party integrations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/one-more-bite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Create or edit a post/page and add the “One More Bite” from the block inserter
  4. Start building your first recipe with structured ingredients and instructions
sections.faq:
Can I import recipes from other formats?

Yes, the One More Bite supports importing from common recipe formats including JSON-LD structured data and popular recipe plugins.

Does it work with any theme?

Absolutely! The One More Bite is designed to work with any WordPress theme and includes responsive styling that adapts to your theme’s design.

Can users submit their own recipes?

The block includes frontend submission capabilities when combined with appropriate user permissions and frontend editing plugins.

Is the nutritional information accurate?

The nutritional calculations are based on USDA food database values and provide good estimates. For precise dietary requirements, consult with nutrition professionals.

Can I customize the recipe card design?

Yes, the block includes multiple design templates and CSS custom properties for easy styling customization.
